Synthetic controller-less pages, captured 2026-11-09 from a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org on a campaign Dev Hub. Each page was submitted independently with sf project deploy start --dry-run, with page metadata and deployment API both set to 59.0 or 67.0. org.tsv records observed acceptance or component rejection; detailed Salesforce messages were not retained. ValidNew is the positive boundary; BadVerb and BadObject are rejection twins.

The scratch org deletion command succeeded. The Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo query including deleted rows returned exactly one record matching the capture's unique description, with Status Deleted. A preliminary run gave the same six outcomes; its deletion command also succeeded and the matching creation-time record showed Deleted, although its ID could not be re-associated after deletion.
